scope: Exact Modern optional and Plex host lifecycle deltas, plus full measured essential shared catalog-generation/VPortal synopsis entry cost. No unrelated cap changes.
measurement: Read accepted tar members in memory, no extraction/rebuild; same pinned Node gzip9 for baseline and all staged platforms.

derivedNative.method: Apply the exact source-bound native icon transformation to manifest-verified web archive bytes. Derived baseline, not independently extracted native artifact; no build or optimization.

dist/player.js.status: Not emitted yet; size gate runs before build-info stamping

src-tauri/frontend/dist/player.js.status: Not emitted yet; size gate runs before build-info stamping

dist-mobile/dist/player.js.status: Not emitted yet; size gate runs before build-info stamping

zeroVportalProviderDeltaPolicy: Record zero only; do not add an unused constant, arithmetic term or report/export field. Shared synopsis growth is part of the measured entry feature delta.
allocation: Modern once in its optional cap and BASE_TOTAL; entry once in BUDGET, LEGACY_TOTAL and BASE_TOTAL; Plex and any nonzero VPortal emitted-asset delta once each in LEGACY_TOTAL and BASE_TOTAL. The entry allowance is the maximum exact matched-platform delta per metric, with each platform recorded separately. TOTAL inherits only these nonzero deltas. No multiplying by platform count or allocating only the overage. Generic provider/optional and unrelated optional caps are unchanged. Shared synopsis code emitted in entry is not also counted as a VPortal provider delta.
limits: Existing build bytes only. This is not release acceptance, source qualification, runtime validation or authorization to install.
